# Subway Seat for Chrome

Colors the tab strip, toolbar, address bar and new-tab page; incognito windows get a faint terracotta frame so you can tell them apart. Works in Edge and Brave too.

[Chrome](https://www.google.com/chrome/) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/chrome/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat/manifest.json`](subway-seat/manifest.json) | the unpacked extension: chrome://extensions › Load unpacked › this folder |
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.zip`](subway-seat.zip) | unzip anywhere, then chrome://extensions › Load unpacked |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel/manifest.json`](subway-seat-tunnel/manifest.json) | the unpacked extension: chrome://extensions › Load unpacked › this folder |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.zip`](subway-seat-tunnel.zip) | unzip anywhere, then chrome://extensions › Load unpacked |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel/manifest.json`](subway-seat-enamel/manifest.json) | the unpacked extension: chrome://extensions › Load unpacked › this folder |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in chrome://extensions (Developer mode on):

```text
Unzip subway-seat.zip, then Load unpacked → pick the subway-seat folder
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in chrome://extensions (Developer mode on):

```text
Unzip subway-seat-tunnel.zip, then Load unpacked → pick the subway-seat-tunnel folder
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in chrome://extensions (Developer mode on):

```text
Unzip subway-seat-enamel.zip, then Load unpacked → pick the subway-seat-enamel folder
```

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
